name: Thundercall Obelisk
desc:
The Thundercall Obelisk is an NPC located in a small cave on the northern side of [Boatman's Watch](location:boatmans_watch). It must be located and interacted with, along with [4 other element-based obelisks](entity:saintsworn_obelisks), to obtain the Saintsworn Oath.

It can only be interacted with if you have at least 15 Thundercall. When interacted with, Tessa, the Hero of Lightning, will speak to the player.
